news.title: New major risk - Market cap size
news.body: The company's market capitalization is less than US$10m. Market cap: ₹908.3m (US$9.83m) This is considered a major risk. Companies with a small market capitalization are most likely businesses that have not yet released a product to market or are simply a very small company without a wide reach. Either way, risk is elevated with these companies because there is a chance the product may not come to fruition or the company's addressable market or demand may not be as large as expected. In addition, if the company's size is the main factor, it is less likely to have many investors and analysts following it and scrutinizing its performance and outlook. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Earnings have declined by 19% per year over the past 5 years.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹2.33 loss per share (vs ₹3.07 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹2.33 loss per share (improved from ₹3.07 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹122.7m (down 13% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹18.5m (loss narrowed 24% from 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 62% per year but the company’s share price has remained flat, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.
